photos.title: Paradise Resort from above
photos.what: Paradise Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): a tower with a blue and orange roof stands on the beach at the label; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Paradise Resort from above, on the beach with the Atlantic Ocean beside it.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Paradise Resort tower on the beach in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-a NAIP records (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and added labels placed from map data

annotation_sources.Paradise Resort: footprint centre of the 208 Horry County parcels of PARADISE RESORT HPR (-78.907243, 33.66829), flood.json footprint_center; label.py
annotation_sources.Atlantic Ocean: given point in the water (-78.905282, 33.667557); label.py

photos.original_size: 1600x1200 crop of a 2400x1800 NAIP export, labels drawn, then resized
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/paradise-resort/ on 2026-11-14. It shows the blue-roofed tower with orange-tile roof sections at the label (the pin sits on its north-west edge), a taller gray tower and a pool to its north-east, the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of the unlabelled crop by tools/photos.js crops, so the share image carries no text.
